zoe: Wrapping up the postmortem follow-ups. Goal: convert findings into concrete, timeboxed actions and avoid this pattern recurring. Please reply with ":thumbsup:" when you accept an item.

zoe: Short recap: transient routing flap during maintenance -> delayed cross-region snapshots -> incomplete restore steps for partial replicas. Pattern note: maintenance-induced config drift + long TTLs amplify impact.

maria: I'll own retention/replication checks. Action: add a nightly cross-region checksum job and a daily retention audit. Create BOARD-789 and attach runner logs. ETA: quick checks by 2026-04-07, automation by 2026-04-21.

ajay: I'll take network failover playbook and a fast-route toggle. Plan: implement a soft-fail flag in our routing controller and a DNS TTL ramp-down script. Prototype linked: https://git/repo/routing-softfail. ETA proto 1w, full by 2026-04-14.

liam: Runbook owner here. I'll add a "maintenance window" appendix with explicit pre-checks for config drift and steps to force KV sync. Also adding a one-click rollback snippet. PR coming: https://git/repo/runbooks/pull/67.

sam: Alerts/telemetry: I'll add an alert for replication mismatch and a synthetic that verifies restore from the latest snapshot in a dry run. Alert IDs will go in BOARD-790. ETA dashboards done 2026-04-08.

zoe: Owners: backups/replication=maria, routing=ajay, runbook=liam, telemetry=sam. I'll add these to the action tracker and tag owners.

maria: quick sample command for the checksum job for reviewers:

```
# cross-region checksum
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/latest/part-0001 - | sha256sum
ssh host-eu 'aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/latest/part-0001 - | sha256sum'
```

ajay: Note: soft-fail toggle will be feature-flagged behind infra-ff. Need infra review. Requesting eng-infra channel review.

liam: Added initial runbook diff in PR. Key new item: "validate replica indices before routing change" + checklist for partial restore.

incident-bot: Created task INC-2026-142: "PM: DR follow-ups sync" and scheduled meeting 2026-04-10T16:00Z.

zoe: Game-day plan: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-12, full failover rehearsal 2026-04-19. Please flag any blackout dates.

maria: 04-12 dry-run ok.

ajay: 04-12 can join prep; 04-19 tentative but should be fine.

sam: both dates good; will ensure synthetic runs pass before rehearsal.

zoe: Final check: reply with owner + short ETA so I can update the tracker.

maria: replication checks + nightly checksum automation -> 2026-04-21. quick audit by 2026-04-07. \u2705

ajay: soft-fail toggle prototype -> 2026-04-10; DNS TTL automation -> 2026-04-14. \u2705

liam: runbook PR -> merge by 2026-04-06, docs + appendix -> 2026-04-13. \u2705

sam: alerts + synthetic restore -> 2026-04-08. \u2705

zoe: Thanks — I'll close this thread after populating INC-2026-142 and cross-link BOARD-789/790. If anything slips, bump this thread or escalate to the DR rota. :rocket:
